knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Section 9.1 and section 2 (superchlorination): free chlorine is raised to at least 10 mg/L while nobody is using the pool.
Section 9.1: the superchlorination dose is applied while nobody is using the pool.
Section 9.1: algae found in chlorinated water signals that free chlorine has slipped below the needed level.

practicalCriteria: On a supplied pool, confirms no bathers and a secured access route before dosing, and records this first.
Brushes and removes dead algae in a supplied scenario, and records the retest that must pass before reopening.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Algae treatment record for the assessed pool
Assessor observation of the bather-free check
stopWorkCriteria: Bathers present during superchlorination: stop dosing and clear the pool.
Dead algae still in the water at reopening: do not reopen; escalate.
Chemical splash to skin or eyes: flush, follow the first-aid procedure and the safety data sheet, and report.
